description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the CompareFaceWithMask operation for masked face comparison 1:1
description_zh: 本文介绍口罩人脸比对1:1CompareFaceWithMask的语法及示例
name: CompareFaceWithMask

parameters.help_en: The URL of image A. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像A的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url_a

parameters.help_en: The URL of image B. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像B的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url_b

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold for face image quality analysis. If the quality score of a face is lower than this threshold, a MessageTips field is added to the response
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值，对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，若某张人脸质量分小于该阈值，则会在返回结果上增加MessageTips说明
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

Confidence.description_en: The confidence score indicating that the largest faces in the two images belong to the same person. Valid values: 0 to 100. Three reference thresholds are 61, 69, and 75, corresponding to false acceptance rates of 1/1000, 1/10000, and 1/100000 respectively. A higher threshold results in a lower false acceptance rate and a lower pass rate. Set a higher threshold for scenarios with higher security requirements. If no face is detected in an image, an error message is returned
Confidence.description_zh: 两张图片中的最大人脸属于同一个人的置信度，取值范围0~100。供参考的三个阈值是61，69，75分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一误识率。阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置更高的阈值。如果某张图片中没有人脸则报错误信息

IsMaskA.description_en:

0: not wearing a mask
1: wearing a mask
IsMaskA.description_zh:

0：不戴口罩
1：戴口罩

IsMaskB.description_en:
Indicates whether the face in image B is wearing a mask.

0: not wearing a mask
1: wearing a mask
IsMaskB.description_zh:
图片B中的人脸是否戴口罩。

0：不戴口罩
1：戴口罩

items.description_zh: 图片B人脸框所对应的人脸关键点坐标，顺序分别为左眼水平坐标，左眼垂直坐标，右眼水平坐标，右眼垂直坐标，鼻尖水平坐标，鼻尖垂直坐标，左嘴角水平坐标，左嘴角垂直坐标，右嘴角水平坐标，右嘴角垂直坐标

MessageTips.description_en:
The tip message in plain text. The following tips may appear individually or in combination.
Quality-related tips (appear when a face quality score is lower than the quality score threshold specified in the request parameter):

`imageA quality score less threshold`: The quality score of image A is lower than the threshold set in the input parameter.
`imageB quality score less threshold`: The quality score of image B is lower than the threshold set in the input parameter.

Face size-related tips (appear when a face is detected but the face width or height is less than 50 pixels. When this tip appears, provide a face with more than 64 × 64 pixels if possible, and use the returned comparison confidence score at your discretion):

`face in imageA is too small`: The face in image A is too small.
`face in imageB is too small`: The face in image B is too small
MessageTips.description_zh:
提示信息，纯文字描述，以下提示信息单独出现或是几条提示信息的组合。
质量相关提示（某张人脸质量分小于请求参数质量分阈值时会出现）：

`imageA quality score less threshold`：图像A的质量分小于输入参数设置的阈值。
`imageB quality score less threshold`：图像B的质量分小于输入参数设置的阈值。

人脸尺寸相关提示（检测到人脸且人脸宽或高小于50像素时会有该提示信息。出现该提示信息时，请尽可能输入像素数大于64x64的人脸，并请酌情参考返回的对比置信度Confidence值）：

`face in imageA is too small`：图像A中的人脸太小。
`face in imageB is too small`：图像B中的人脸太小

Thresholds.description_en: The array of confidence thresholds at different false acceptance rates
Thresholds.description_zh: 不同误识率下置信度结果数组

items.description_en: The confidence thresholds corresponding to false acceptance rates of 1/1000, 1/10000, and 1/100000. For example, `[61.0,69.0,75.0]` indicates that at a false acceptance rate of 1/1000, a confidence score (Confidence) exceeding 61% means the two faces can be considered the same person
items.description_zh: 误识率在1/1000，1/10000，1/100000的情况下分别对应的置信度阈值。例如`[61.0,69.0,75.0]`，表示误识率为1/1000的情况下，置信度（Confidence）超过61%就可以认为是同一个人
